title: Occupancy, Bedding and Pet Charges across the Hotel Rate Plans Range
content:
Charges for an occupant beyond the rate's standard occupancy, for a cot or a rollaway bed, and for a pet are contracted plan by plan. The schedule below states them for every plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Extra adult, per night | Extra child, per night | Child free up to and including age | Cot, per night | Rollaway, per night | Pet, per stay | Pet weight limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 45.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 5 | 15.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 125.00 USD | 9 kg |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 40.00 USD | 22.00 USD | 5 | 15.00 USD | 32.00 USD | 110.00 USD | 9 kg |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 35.00 USD | 20.00 USD | 11 | 12.00 USD | 30.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 14 kg |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 30.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 11 | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 85.00 USD | 18 kg |
| Member Flex Rate | 25.00 USD | 12.00 USD | 12 | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 18 kg |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 12 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 23 kg |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 85.00 USD | 55.00 USD | 12 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 175.00 USD | 23 kg |

The extra adult and extra child amounts are charged per additional occupant per night beyond the rate's standard occupancy, the child amount applying beyond the free age limit in the third column. The cot and rollaway amounts are charged per night. The pet amount is charged once for the whole stay, and the weight limit is the heaviest pet the plan accepts.

*Worked reading, hypothetical figures.* A party on the Semi-Flexible Rate takes one extra adult for a four-night stay: the extra adult amount of 35.00 USD multiplied by four nights is 140.00 USD. On the Suite Flexible Rate the same party would be charged nothing for the extra adult, that plan's amount being 0.00 USD, while its pet amount of 150.00 USD is the second highest in the range.
